introduction: Utah 211 offers local referrals by county or ZIP code. Its directory and navigators help find services but do not approve an application.
description: Utah 211 offers local referrals by county or ZIP code. Its directory and navigators help find services but do not approve an application.

sections.who: Anyone seeking community-resource information can contact the free, confidential service.
sections.get: Referrals to local services, with multilingual assistance.
sections.docs:
• Your ZIP code or county.
  • The need, urgency and practical access requirements.
sections.apply:
1. Search or call

    Use Utah 211 or dial 211/888-826-9790.

  2. Explain what you need

    Ask for providers serving your location.

  3. Confirm local intake

    Contact the referred organization about availability.
sections.after: Keep referral details and ask for another option if the provider cannot assist.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Utah211 current contact options. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is the phone service available overnight?
The current site lists daytime hours; check them before calling.
The site lists texting your ZIP code to 801-845-2211 during navigator hours.
Utah 211 describes the service as confidential.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
